initiative.title: Coax Nostr: our own Nostr stack, crypto included, in Coax
initiative.body: Build shared Coax Nostr crypto, verified clients and runtime authority for web, iOS, native tools and Verse. Source-pinned schemas/codecs and TypeScript-backed snapshots exist; the socket byte pipe is shipped, while Coax crypto, live folding and admission remain open. Named profiles and evidence govern support, with independent review before production secrets or retirement. Specification: coax/nostr.md.

milestones.title: Profiles, assurance and production gates
milestones.body: Named limits, independent vectors/oracles, entropy, erasure, secret-path evidence and independent review. Foundation work starts first; production approval is a later gate, not a block on test-key development.

milestones.title: Coax compiler prerequisites
milestones.body: Small compiler features and fixes the stack wants; none blocks M0–M2.

milestones.title: A relay client in the page
milestones.body: Host random, socket and storage imports; the relay state machine with NIP-42 AUTH.

milestones.title: Hashes and ciphers
milestones.body: Byte helpers, SHA-256, HMAC, HKDF, PBKDF2, ChaCha20, hex and base64 in Coax, each against its official vectors.

milestones.title: Events and encodings
milestones.body: Bounded JSON, exact read-only NIP-01 hash/verify first; signed-event construction is separate. Bech32, safe integer-only JCS and envelope contracts remain explicit.

milestones.title: Field and scalar arithmetic
milestones.body: secp256k1 field elements (10×26) and scalars mod n, with inversion and square root, proven bounds and differential tests.

milestones.title: Group arithmetic and Schnorr verify
milestones.body: Points, wNAF dual multiplication and BIP-340 verification.

milestones.title: The project page goes live
milestones.body: Extend shipped socket/frame plumbing into a live task fold, then local verification before authoritative use. Informational work notices are distinct from fenced worker claims.

milestones.title: Signing and ECDH
milestones.body: Fixed-base comb, constant-time ladder, BIP-340 signing and x-only ECDH, with timing evidence.

milestones.title: NIP-44 and NIP-59
milestones.body: Version 2 encryption, seals and gift wraps that interoperate with spec implementations.

milestones.title: Durable clients and signer interfaces
milestones.body: Verified event lifecycle, offline state, multi-relay catch-up, optional relay discovery and correlated signer requests.

milestones.title: Real Coax domain adapters
milestones.body: Use existing generated proto codecs with source evidence and policy; expand missing definitions only for real consumers.

milestones.title: Sign in to the website with your phone
milestones.body: Shared iOS vectors, device-only Keychain software-key custody, NIP-46 permissions/lifecycle, QR and NIP-98 sessions. Throwaway tests first; production identity waits for review.

milestones.title: Block ownership and federated identity
milestones.body: OA/AA current owner admission, selected asymmetric JWS/JWKS profiles, FI community policy and FA credential sessions.

milestones.title: HOST, REACH and real delegated work
milestones.body: Scoped original grants, fresh authenticated routes, fenced worker claims, truthful task journals and a real Linux Codex task from the app.

milestones.title: Channels, artifacts and archive consent
milestones.body: Live membership/visibility, CW bounded completeness, AR transactional history and IA consent.

milestones.title: Private agent data and optional messaging
milestones.body: AE/AP/AO/AM privacy and exact state; separately scoped NIP-17 private conversations.

milestones.title: Replace the TypeScript
milestones.body: Reviewed versioned unlock migration, native tools and idempotent project publisher; retire working TypeScript only after production cutover and rollback evidence.

milestones.title: Optional encrypted key backup
milestones.body: NIP-49 primitives, normalization and bounded owner-approved ncryptsec import/export.

milestones.title: Consumer conformance and support publication
milestones.body: Advertise only target/profile behavior backed by executable positive and negative evidence.

tasks.title: Compound assignment through a view emits valid C
tasks.body: Shipped in e2f8432ea2: compound assignment through indexed views now emits a C lvalue even when the index calls a procedure. Preserve its focused native regression. This task is resolved; it does not establish general compiler correctness.
acceptance: The committed view/index-call regression in e2f8432ea2 compiles and runs; retain the test on affected emitter changes

tasks.title: A value_barrier intrinsic for constant-time code
tasks.body: Shipped in b9a5f216f0: optimizer-opaque u32/u64 identity, native register barrier and Wasm non-inlined fallback, checked evaluator/checker behavior and focused codegen tests. Preserve its focused regressions. This does not establish whole-library constant time or secure erasure.
acceptance: Retain committed constant_time.py and checker/evaluator regressions from b9a5f216f0; crypto-secret-codegen separately validates full algorithms and target profiles

tasks.title: Explicit wrapping add and rotate for u32 and u64
tasks.body: Add `add_wrap`, `sub_wrap`, `mul_wrap`, `rotl`, `rotr` for u32/u64 that never trap in any build mode. SHA-256 and ChaCha20 can use them instead of computing in u64 and masking.
acceptance: Tests for each op at the type's limits in debug and --release
coax/tests pass

tasks.title: mul_wide: a 64×64→128 multiply as two u64 halves
tasks.body: Add mul_wide(a,b:u64) returning the compiler-owned CoaxU64Product {hi:u64,lo:u64}. Current Coax has named records rather than general tuple returns. Native C uses unsigned __int128; wasm32 uses four32-bit partial products. Checked and wrapping modes, compile-time evaluation and left-to-right once-only argument evaluation share the same exact result. Enables later5x52 native field optimization; the current10x26 field arithmetic can proceed with bounded u64 schedules.
acceptance: Random and edge vectors match a reference computed with __int128 on native and in wasm32 (node or a headless page)
coax/tests pass

tasks.title: Debug-only struct fields and checks
tasks.body: A way to declare fields and statements that exist only in development builds (spec §10.5 conditional compilation, the minimal slice), so field elements can carry magnitudes in debug and not in release.
acceptance: A struct with a debug-only field has a smaller size_of in --release; statements under the debug condition are absent from release C
coax/tests pass

tasks.title: Named support profiles, limits and source evidence
tasks.body: Define core-read/write, phone-signer, openagents-host, Block identity/channel/private-agent and optional backup profiles. Record target/source pins, implementation/evidence, original/decoded/frame/tag/queue/storage limits and compatibility. Reconcile existing proto vs proposed JSON vs socket limits without claiming universal Nostr limits.
acceptance: Machine-readable matrix rejects unsupported advertised support and inconsistent consumer bounds
Boundary fixtures demonstrate clean refusals; profiles name real consumers and optional official NIPs

tasks.title: Byte helpers: big/little-endian loads, constant-time equality and select
tasks.body: Bounded endian loads/stores, ct_eq returning a mask and ct_select for words/views. Explicit checked-safe mask arithmetic in both modes, no unsigned underflow depending on --release. Secure erasure is a separate contract (crypto-secure-zero), not a foreign no-op or register barrier claim.
acceptance: Boundary/capacity/alias/endianness and both mask values pass #test and emitted checked/optimized native tests
Zero surviving mutants in the helpers; independently seeded wrong selection is detected

tasks.title: Pin the official test vectors with their sources and hashes
tasks.body: Pin the official vectors listed in coax/nostr.md §9 with upstream URL, revision/license, retrieval date and SHA-256. Keep upstream bytes; distinguish adapted Wycheproof/derived fixtures and record source hashes. BIP-340 has 19 rows including variable-message cases.
acceptance: A check detects modified/missing upstream vector files and source/hash mismatch
Derived cases retain original input identity and reproducible adapter description

tasks.title: A native vector runner for Coax crypto modules
tasks.body: tools/coax-nostr/vectors.sh builds each module with `coax c` → clang with ASan/UBSan and runs a C driver per vector file, reporting pass/fail per row. Heavy vectors run here; small ones also run as #test.
acceptance: Native Coax-to-C vector runners use ASan/UBSan and report each row/input hash
Corrupting one expected result and one actual algorithm result in temporary copies both fail; no comparison only to our generated output

tasks.title: SHA-256, streaming and one-shot, with the BIP-340 tagged hash
tasks.body: Streaming init/update/final, one-shot and BIP-340 tagged hashes. Extract/generalize the checked algorithm from coax/lib/proto/fingerprint.coax without changing compiler provenance bytes; that module explicitly was not an admission/signature API. Avoid a second uncoordinated SHA implementation.
acceptance: NIST vectors, padding and streaming chunk boundaries agree with an independent oracle
Existing compiler fingerprint fixtures retain their exact digests if shared helpers change
Zero surviving mutants; emitted checked/optimized parity; native/Wasm throughput is measured with target/profile metadata

tasks.title: HMAC-SHA256 and HKDF
tasks.body: coax/lib/crypto/hmac.coax and hkdf.coax: hmac_sha256(key, msg), HKDF extract and expand (NIP-44 uses expand with 76 bytes).
acceptance: RFC 4231 cases 1–7 and RFC 5869 cases 1–3 pass
coax mutate: no surviving mutants

tasks.title: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256
tasks.body: coax/lib/crypto/pbkdf2.coax for the phrase gate (210,000 rounds); reuse the HMAC inner/outer state per round.
acceptance: RFC 7914 §11 vectors, iteration/output bounds and error cleanup pass
Measure the declared 210000-round gate profile on real Wasm; bounded work does not block rendering, with slower-device behavior explicit

tasks.title: ChaCha20 block function and stream cipher
tasks.body: coax/lib/crypto/chacha20.coax per RFC 8439 §2.3–2.4: 32-byte key, 12-byte nonce, 32-bit counter; xor stream into caller buffer.
acceptance: coax mutate: no surviving mutants
≥ 250 MB/s in wasm32

tasks.title: Bounded hex and base64 codecs
tasks.body: coax/lib/nostr/hex.coax and base64.coax (standard alphabet, with padding, as NIP-44 uses): encode and strict decode into caller buffers; refuse bad characters, bad padding and overflow.
acceptance: RFC 4648 §10 vectors pass
Every invalid NIP-44 base64 case is refused
coax mutate: no surviving mutants

tasks.title: Enforce the supported secret-path and variable-time boundary
tasks.body: Specify and implement a narrow inspectable source/dataflow policy for secret entry points. Reject unsupported constructs, secret branches/indices and calls to public-only _vartime code. Do not advertise #secret syntax before it exists.
acceptance: Negative fixtures for secret branch/index/callee and unsupported flow are rejected
Accepted masked operations execute in checked/optimized modes; scope and gaps are documented

tasks.title: Field elements in 10×26 limbs: load, store, normalize, add, negate
tasks.body: 10x26 field representation, checked magnitude/normalization discipline, load/store, normalize, add/negate and equality. Use an explicit debug representation if conditional fields are not implemented; do not claim #if exists. Bound masks and all secret-path choices in both compiler modes.
acceptance: #test round-trips for 0, 1, p−1, 2^256−1 mod p and limb-boundary values
Magnitude violations trap in debug builds (negative tests)

tasks.title: A differential harness against libsecp256k1
tasks.body: Pin and inspect libsecp source/license/hash before explicitly reviewed harness builds. Public APIs do not expose arbitrary field/scalar internals: choose a reviewed pinned white-box adapter or independent big-integer oracle for those operations. ECDH comparisons use a custom raw-x callback, never the default compressed-point hash.
acceptance: Field/scalar/point/Schnorr/raw-x ECDH adapter contracts and pinned identities are documented
Seeded field carry and ECDH default-hash faults are detected by the harness
A bounded differential smoke passes; milestone runs retain one-hour seed/artifact evidence

tasks.title: Field multiply and square with compile-time bound proofs
tasks.body: mul and sqr with reduction by 2^256 ≡ 2^32 + 977; #run/#assert prove the largest accumulator stays below 2^64 for inputs of magnitude ≤ 8. The selected10x26 implementation proves a bounded u64 convolution/fold schedule; mul_wide is reserved for a later5x52 optimization and is not required for this representation.
acceptance: Compile-time bounds cover every actual product/accumulator/carry/fold at admitted magnitudes; a deliberately exceeding bound fails (do not assume magnitude 9 alone overflows)
1000000 random products plus limb/carry edges match the pinned independent oracle
Zero surviving mutants and emitted sanitizer checks

tasks.title: Field inversion and square root with fixed addition chains
tasks.body: inv (a^(p−2)) and sqrt (a^((p+1)/4), returning whether a root exists), constant time, plus inv_vartime for public inputs (may initially call inv).
acceptance: a·inv(a) = 1 for 100,000 random a; sqrt(a²) = ±a; non-residues refused
Matches libsecp harness on edge values

tasks.title: Scalars mod n in 8×32 limbs
tasks.body: 8x32 scalar arithmetic modulo n with explicit split-product/carry scheduling and compile-time bounds for each accumulator: one 32x32 product fits u64 but a sum may overflow. Canonical load/store, overflow/zero checks, add/mul/negate/inverse and windows; secret-path reduction is branch/index independent.
acceptance: Compile-time bound checks cover multiplication/reduction intermediates; seeded carry loss is caught
0, 1, n-1, n, 2^256-1 and 1000000 random operations match the independent oracle
Checked/optimized results agree; zero surviving mutants

tasks.title: Points: affine and Jacobian add, double and mixed add
tasks.body: Affine/Jacobian points, lifts and validation, add/double/mixed operations and masked table selection. Specify complete formulas or masked exceptional handling for secret paths including P=Q, P=-Q, infinity and invalid points; verification-only variable-time helpers are separate.
acceptance: Independent generator/random points and infinity/P=Q/P=-Q/invalid-lift cases match
Secret-path exceptional inputs never select secret branches/indices; zero surviving mutants

tasks.title: wNAF dual multiplication a·G + b·P for verification
tasks.body: coax/lib/crypto/secp_mult.coax: ecmult_vartime(a, P, b) using wNAF (window 5 for P, a precomputed G table generated with #run). Public inputs only; name ends _vartime.
acceptance: 100,000 random (a, P, b) match the harness
Precomputed table generated at compile time within the step budget

tasks.title: BIP-340 Schnorr verification
tasks.body: General byte-view BIP-340 verification plus a Nostr wrapper for a 32-byte event ID. Refuse invalid lifts, r>=p, s>=n and malformed lengths. Read-only verification does not depend on signing, keys, AUTH or erasure.
acceptance: All 19 official verification rows including message lengths 0, 1, 17 and 100 match
A one-hour differential run vs pinned libsecp retains seeds and regressions
Record native/Wasm verify time and actual target/profile; performance cannot waive correctness

tasks.title: Bounded JSON pull parser and writer
tasks.body: Shipped in 8f23a77f35: bounded Coax JSON pull parser/writer, UTF-8 and escape handling, fixed input/depth/string limits, 267 JSONTestSuite cases and captured-relay native trapping-allocator tests. Its json_int admits ±2^53 and duplicate object keys are not domain-policy checked. New profile/duplicate/safe-integer hardening is a separate task, not a claim that this parser did not ship.
acceptance: Retain the committed JSONTestSuite/captured-relay/native no-allocation regressions from 8f23a77f35
Coax event-domain conformance and new consumer limits are explicitly not established by this resolved parser task

tasks.title: JSON consumer profiles, duplicate keys and safe integer admission
tasks.body: Build on the shipped parser without reopening its completed task. Enforce per-consumer decoded/raw limits and duplicate-key refusal in signed event/JWS/envelope domains; narrow safe-integer projection to 2^53-1 where required. Preserve raw/original numeric bytes and choose explicit error/unknown policy.
acceptance: Duplicate escaped/equivalent object keys and ambiguous security-critical fields refuse in domain adapters
±(2^53-1), ±2^53, raw numeric retention and mismatched content/frame/proto limits follow the selected profile
Existing parser vectors remain compatible except explicitly versioned consumer admission

tasks.title: NIP-01 events: parse, serialize IDs and verify
tasks.body: Read-only parse, exact NIP-01 canonical ID serialization/hash and BIP-340 verification with profile limits. Preserve original JSON, ordered tags, unknown fields and exact content. Freshness is consumer admission, not signature validity. Signing moves to nostr-event-sign so verified public reads do not wait for secret-key features.
acceptance: Escape/non-ASCII/astral/empty-tag preimages match independent event-hash implementations
Altered fields/ID/signature, invalid point, malformed/duplicate keys and capacity refusals have negative vectors
The task dependency closure contains no signing, keys or NIP-42 task

tasks.title: The page verifies one real event in Coax
tasks.body: Dev-only real-event probe using the actual shared canonical event reader/ID serializer/verifier, not a second minimal implementation. Baked public fixture, no signing or production key dependency.
acceptance: ID/content/signature tampering and out-of-profile input show REFUSED; an independently verified real fixture shows VERIFIED
Visuals check passes; no signing dependency in this task closure

tasks.title: A dudect-style constant-time timing harness
tasks.body: tools/coax-nostr/timing/: fixed-vs-random class runs with Welch's t-test, native (Apple silicon and x86-64) and a wasm32 report mode.
acceptance: Seeded secret-branch/index leakage is detected with retained class counts/statistics and noise conditions
Declared native arm64/x86-64 runs record at least 10^6 samples and t statistics; no-detected-leak is never labelled a proof
Wasm browser results are reported by engine/tier/flags with no universal timing guarantee

tasks.title: Constant-time fixed-base multiplication k·G
tasks.body: Comb method with a table generated by #run (32 KB variant for the page, 64 KB native); every lookup through ge_table_select; no secret branches.
acceptance: 100000 random scalars and boundary scalars match the independent oracle
Record actual table-generation budget and emitted table/stack size
Timing probe reports no detected leakage for the declared native profile; generated-code audit remains separate

tasks.title: Constant-time variable-base multiplication k·P
tasks.body: A fixed-window (4-bit) constant-time multiplication for ECDH, with signed-digit recoding and masked table selection.
acceptance: 100000 random scalar/peer pairs and exceptional points match
Secret branches/indices are forbidden by the documented source scope; timing probe records methodology without claiming proof

tasks.title: Secure erasure and bounded secret-copy contract
tasks.body: Define secure_zero with observable stores and bounded scratch/copy/ABI rules. A value barrier alone does not preserve erasure. Inspect optimized/LTO objects with no post-wipe test observation; cover errors, cancellation and aliases.
acceptance: Native/Wasm optimized artifacts retain required wipe stores under declared toolchains
Injected omitted wipe/early-return/copy escape fails; unsupported erasure guarantees are explicit

tasks.title: BIP-340 signing with auxiliary randomness
tasks.body: General byte-view BIP-340 sign(message,seckey32,aux32), with a Nostr 32-byte wrapper. Validate 1<=key<n, parity normalization, auxiliary randomness, zero nonce refusal and final self-verification. Caller-owned bounded scratch and failure wiping; no partial signature released.
acceptance: All official signing rows match byte for byte including non-32-byte messages
Invalid/zero key, zero nonce and injected self-verification failure release no signature and wipe owned scratch
Checked/optimized/native/Wasm results agree; timing is no-detected-leak evidence, not proof

tasks.title: x-only ECDH shared secret
tasks.body: Validated raw shared x for NIP-44: refuse invalid peer points/scalars/infinity. The libsecp oracle must supply the raw-x callback; default secp256k1_ecdh hashes a compressed point and is the wrong oracle.
acceptance: Official conversation-key and labelled adapted Wycheproof cases agree with independent raw-x computation
Seeded use of the default libsecp hash callback is detected; error paths wipe scratch

tasks.title: NIP-44 version 2 encrypt and decrypt
tasks.body: Pinned NIP-44 v2 conversation/message keys, padding and ChaCha20/HMAC. MAC authenticates nonce||ciphertext before plaintext release; caller supplies fresh entropy. Support the six-byte prefix at >=65536 or explicitly refuse it under a named bounded profile. Outer event verification is mandatory at the signed-event integration boundary.
acceptance: All upstream valid/invalid vectors and 65535/65536/65537 extended-prefix boundary fixtures pass or produce the advertised capacity refusal
Wrong MAC/version/nonce/padding/alias/capacity never releases plaintext; zero surviving mutants
Independent encrypt/decrypt interoperability in both directions, with no production key

Every advertised payload maximum closes the real encrypt/base64/event-write/event-read/decrypt path, or refuses before emitting an event its selected reader cannot admit; raw-string, content, frame and crypto limits cannot silently disagree.

tasks.title: Build signed events over the verified event core
tasks.body: Separate event building/signing from nostr-event read-only verification. Caller provides explicit aux/nonce entropy; bind identity/body/preimage and verify produced signature before release. No browser-host dependency in pure module.
acceptance: 10000 independent signed-event round trips agree including Unicode and empty fields
Bad signer output, invalid key and partial failure release no event or secret scratch

tasks.title: NIP-59 rumor, seal and gift wrap
tasks.body: coax/lib/nostr/nip59.coax: build rumor (unsigned), seal (kind 13, signed by author, NIP-44 to recipient), wrap (kind 1059 from a fresh key, randomized created_at within two days back); unwrap verifies wrap sig, decrypts, verifies seal sig and that rumor pubkey equals seal pubkey.
acceptance: Independent wrap/seal interoperability in both directions, including the existing test deck
Reject altered outer signature, bad seal signature, rumor identity mismatch, missing recipient and oversized private payload
Fresh wrap keys/nonces/timestamp policy and failure cleanup are covered

tasks.title: RFC 8785 canonical JSON for contract digests
tasks.body: Explicit integer-only RFC8785 envelope profile: UTF-16 member ordering, exact string rules and safe-integer bounds, preserving original input. Refuse floats/out-of-range integers instead of claiming general JCS support.
acceptance: Independent integer-only/astral-key/safe-number boundary fixtures agree
Unsupported numeric values refuse; existing test-deck envelope digest remains byte-identical

tasks.title: The 3188 artifact envelope
tasks.body: coax/lib/nostr/envelope.coax: build and check openagents.artifact-envelope.v1 (inline body, digest = SHA-256 of JCS bytes, 1 MiB cap) per nips/openagents/contracts.md.
acceptance: Builds byte-identical envelopes to coax/web/unlock/lib.ts for the test deck
Refuses a digest mismatch and an oversize body

tasks.title: Open today's sealed deck natively with the Coax stack
tasks.body: A native test that fetches the sealed test deck's wrap fixture (checked in from the scratch e2e, test deck only), unwraps it with the recipient test key, checks the 3188 envelope digest and prints the slide titles.
acceptance: Prints the two test-deck slide titles; digest matches

tasks.title: REQ filters: build and match locally
tasks.body: coax/lib/nostr/filter.coax: ids, authors, kinds, #<tag>, since, until, limit; serialize to JSON and match an event locally (to drop events a relay shouldn't have sent).
acceptance: #test matrix of filter × event matches NIP-01 semantics

tasks.title: bech32 and NIP-19 entities
tasks.body: BIP-173 bech32 (not bech32m) and NIP-19 npub/nsec/note/TLV entities with source-specific limits and unknown-type handling. Decode nsec only into caller-owned secret buffers, with explicit lifecycle supplied by keys.coax.
acceptance: BIP-173 valid/invalid vectors and NIP-19 examples agree with independent codecs
10000 random entities plus unknown TLV/length/capacity cases agree; nsec never logged

tasks.title: CSPRNG contract across native, iOS and browser
tasks.body: Define explicit entropy/auxiliary inputs, errors and test injection. OS/browser adapters fail closed, chunk browser requests and never substitute clock/PRNG bytes. Low-level Coax algorithms remain host-independent.
acceptance: Native/iOS/browser absence/short/invalid-span/oversize cases fail without output
Deterministic entropy is only available through test adapters

tasks.title: Host import: random bytes
tasks.body: coax/web/host.js: `random(ptr, len)` from crypto.getRandomValues (chunked at 65,536 bytes); a page without it refuses to run crypto.
acceptance: Browser CSPRNG adapter fills requested lengths including >65536 through chunking
Unavailable entropy/invalid spans fail closed with no clock/Math.random fallback; deterministic injection exists only in test API

tasks.title: Host import: a WebSocket byte pipe
tasks.body: Shipped in df008f96a4: generic host socket open/send/close, bounded text frames and open/frame/close/error inbox messages. socket.coax and project-live.coax exercise subscriptions, reconnect and a real frame counter. Task rows still use verified build-time snapshots; parsed live folding, Coax signature verification and NIP-42 readiness remain separate open tasks.
acceptance: Retain the socket.coax and project-live.coax scripted inbox/open/frame/close/error checks from df008f96a4
The committed real-page frame counter probe connects to relay.openagents.com; no live task-fold claim is implied

tasks.title: Host import: IndexedDB bytes
tasks.body: store_put/get/delete over one IndexedDB object store per origin; results via the inbox; private browsing failure reported, not thrown.
acceptance: Put/reload/get/delete generation-safe byte transfers pass
Unavailable/quota/oversize/cancelled/late response states refuse cleanly; deleted records do not reappear

tasks.title: NIP-42 AUTH events
tasks.body: Bound kind22242 AUTH builder and signer handoff for current relay/challenge/connection generation. Proof of possession does not grant channel or host-operation authority.
acceptance: Independent tags/signatures match; old challenge/relay/generation responses are refused

tasks.title: The relay client state machine
tasks.body: Pure bounded verified client machine with connection/subscription generations, REQ/CLOSE/EVENT/OK/EOSE/CLOSED/NOTICE/AUTH, acknowledgement deadlines, cancellation, duplicate suppression and capped jittered reconnect. AUTH-required retry is once per authenticated generation. EOSE/short page never claims completeness; public reads need not wait for AUTH when the relay permits them.
acceptance: Scripted transcripts cover ACK true/false/timeout, AUTH/reconnect, stale generations, duplicates, unknown subscriptions, queue overflow and forged events
No host I/O inside Coax state machine; profile limits have clean refusal states

tasks.title: Correlated local, NIP-07 and phone signer requests
tasks.body: Shared signer request/result/cancel contract with requested identity/body/target/scope, bounded IDs/deadlines, verified output and explicit approvals. Pure decisions with thin NIP-07 effect adapter; supports test keys before production approval.
acceptance: Independent/fake signer output tampering, wrong identity/body, duplicate/late replies and denial are refused
Local test slot and NIP-07 adapter implement same bounded lifecycle; no default persistent browser nsec

tasks.title: Key slots, storage records and the NIP-07 adapter
tasks.body: SecretSlot/forget and versioned key records. Prefer phone/NIP-46 or NIP-07 signer; explicit local browser slots are ephemeral by default. No new plaintext nsec IndexedDB persistence. Durable encrypted exports wait for the optional NIP-49 task; document legacy unlock-store migration.
acceptance: Ephemeral slot import/forget and all error paths wipe bounded owned buffers; no key in logs/public state
Returned signer output is correlated and verified for identity/body/scope
Legacy storage migration/deletion failure states are explicit; no plaintext-persistence default

tasks.title: The page subscribes to relay.openagents.com with AUTH
tasks.body: Wire host pipes and relay.coax into a probe page: connect, answer AUTH with a test key, subscribe to a known filter, draw verified event count and refusals.
acceptance: Probe on staging shows the expected count from relay.openagents.com
A REQ is never sent before AUTH completes (asserted from the outbox log)

tasks.title: Open the hidden deck in Coax
tasks.body: Replace coax/web/unlock/page.ts: fetch the wrap through relay.coax with AUTH as the recipient, unwrap with nip59.coax, check the envelope, hand slides to ui.coax.
acceptance: The real phrase opens the deck on staging with page.ts removed
Wrong key shows the key-wrong state

tasks.title: Review a versioned phrase-gate format and migration
tasks.body: Specify KDF/salt/domain-separated keys/nonces, authenticated version/length/MAC input, failure/capacity/work limits and old/new readers. Keep existing AES-GCM until independently reviewed replacement and rollback. No unproven same-security claim.
acceptance: Independent format review pins exact bytes/algorithms and resolves findings before implementation
Immutable old/new/wrong-MAC/nonce/version vectors and staged rollback window documented

tasks.title: The phrase gate in Coax, without AES
tasks.body: Implement only the independently reviewed versioned phrase-gate format, authenticated framing/domain separation/nonces/KDF bounds and dual-reader migration specified by unlock-gate-format. Existing AES-GCM adapter remains until cutover/rollback evidence exists.
acceptance: Pinned old/new fixtures, wrong phrase/MAC/version/nonce/length, oversize work and failure cleanup pass
Staging replacement preserves access during the declared window; rollback restores old readers/entries

tasks.title: coax-nostr: a native CLI for keygen, seal, gate, publish and verify
tasks.body: tools/coax-nostr/: a native program built from the same modules: keygen, seal deck.md --author --to, gate (writes unlock entries for deploy.sh), publish (sign and send events to a relay with AUTH, using a small native socket), verify, fetch.
acceptance: deploy.sh runs the gate step with coax-nostr and no bun
Re-sealing the deck with coax-nostr opens on staging

tasks.title: Publish the Coax project and its tasks as Nostr events
tasks.body: Replace the already-working TS publisher with native Coax tooling. Preserve every existing issue ID/slug, signed revision/status/plan history and project order. First publication has already shipped; this task is implementation migration, not creating duplicate issues.
acceptance: Readback signatures/IDs/fields agree with current publisher; existing issue IDs do not change
Second publish emits nothing; comments/plans/resolved states survive migration

tasks.title: The Coax Nostr library runs on iOS against the same vectors
tasks.body: Build the Coax Nostr modules (hashes, secp256k1, Schnorr, ECDH, NIP-44, events, bech32) as C for iOS arm64 and the simulator through the app's Generated/ build step, and run the shared vector files in the iOS test target. Report sign and verify times on a device.
acceptance: Same BIP-340/NIP-44/event files pass via generated C on simulator and actual iOS arm64 when available
Entropy/ABI/lifetime/alias/error tests and simulator timings recorded; physical-device evidence is separately recorded, never inferred

tasks.title: One vector corpus on native, Wasm and iOS
tasks.body: Execute the same pinned full-vector corpus and malformed-input cases through actual emitted checked/optimized C, Chrome/Safari/Firefox Wasm and iOS C ABI. Device unavailable is an explicit owner step, not silently passed.
acceptance: Artifact/input hashes and per-target results agree; seeded wrong output is detected
Simulator and physical-device results are separate; missing required targets prevent cutover

tasks.title: Inspect secret-path lowering on real targets
tasks.body: Audit generated objects for scalar multiplication, sign, ECDH, MAC compare and erasure across arm64/x86-64 and wasm profiles. Pin compiler/toolchain/flags/LTO/artifact hashes; browser JIT results are bounded observations.
acceptance: Seeded branch/index/removed-wipe faults fail the inspection pipeline
Target/profile reports identify unsupported claims and record real browser execution

tasks.title: Independent review before production cryptography
tasks.body: Independent reviewers assess arithmetic bounds, group exceptions, nonce/signing, serialization, protocols, erasure and compiler/host boundaries. Resolve findings and pin exact reviewed source/artifact evidence. Self-review and mutation/timing scores are not substitutes.
acceptance: Review report names independent reviewers and reviewed hashes; no unresolved blocking findings
Changing reviewed crypto/compiler/ABI inputs invalidates the affected approval rather than silently inheriting it

tasks.title: NIP-46 remote signer (bunker side) in Coax
tasks.body: NIP-46 bunker side with distinct client/remote-signer/user identities, one-use connect secret and correlated kind24133 requests. Semantic permissions include kind+target+operation/scope/expiry, not a blanket kind allowlist. Unsupported NIP-04 methods return explicit errors.
acceptance: Independent client connect/get_public_key/sign_event/ping/nip44 round trips pass
Wrong/reused secret, identity confusion, ungranted target/scope, replay and altered returned event are refused
No production identity involved in development tests

tasks.title: The phone holds the user's Nostr key in the Keychain
tasks.body: Device-only Keychain storage, owner-approved create/import/export and per-operation/session user-presence policy. Coax secp256k1 software signing briefly exposes bounded secret memory; do not claim Secure Enclave isolation. Tests use throwaway keys. Production identity rollout waits for nostr-production-cutover.
acceptance: Simulator tests exercise create/import/sign/forget, denial and background timeout with throwaway keys
Device-only Keychain/user-presence settings and bounded key/copy wiping are inspected; no secret logs
Device owner step and production cutover prerequisite are recorded

tasks.title: QR code encoder in Coax
tasks.body: Byte mode, error correction M, versions 1 to 15, mask selection by the standard penalty rules; output a module grid the page draws as HUD strokes or quads.
acceptance: Matches a reference encoder's module grids for 20 fixed strings including a 300-byte nostrconnect URI
A phone camera (the iOS scanner test) decodes a rendered code

tasks.title: NIP-46 permissions, revocation and phone suspension
tasks.body: Bound semantic method/kind/target/scope permissions, replay/correlation, one-use connect, switch_relays/logout, denial/expiry, foreground approval and suspended-phone timeout. Client/signer/user identities remain distinct.
acceptance: Independent transcript tests cover reused secret, revoked permission, replay, switched relay and logout
Suspension/resume/late approval cannot sign an expired or differently scoped request

tasks.title: Scan a sign-in code with the phone and approve
tasks.body: The app's QR scanner recognises nostrconnect:// codes, shows the site and what it asks for in an approval sheet, and on approval runs the NIP-46 signer for that session; the session shows in Settings and can be ended there.
acceptance: Fixture QR opens owner approval; untrusted site metadata cannot grant permission
Deny/end-session/replay/suspension are tested; foreground resumption cannot approve an expired request

tasks.title: NIP-46 client in the page
tasks.body: The page side of Nostr Connect: an ephemeral client key, the nostrconnect:// URI (relay, secret, perms, name, url), waiting for the signer's connect, then get_public_key and sign_event requests over the page's relay client.
acceptance: In-memory independent client/signer round trips verify distinct signer/user keys and get_public_key
Relay switching/logout, duplicate IDs, timeout and late response behavior are explicit; ephemeral key wiped on sign-out

tasks.title: The server verifies NIP-98 HTTP auth and issues a session
tasks.body: A native Coax server route POST /auth/nostr takes a NIP-98 kind 27235 event (url, method, payload hash, created_at within 60 s, unused id), verifies it with the Coax verifier, and sets an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict session cookie bound to the pubkey. Admin pubkeys come from config. No WorkOS.
acceptance: Valid throwaway login accepted; wrong URL/method/body/time/signature rejected
Replay reservation is atomic across workers and restart for the acceptance window
Bounded request/replay parsing has deterministic refusal; no key material in cookie

tasks.title: NIP-98 session expiry, revocation and CSRF policy
tasks.body: Complete production HTTP sessions after signed login: atomic replay window across restarts/workers, fixation/CSRF policy, scoped roles, cookie rotation, expiry, logout/revocation and cleanup. Login does not imply administration.
acceptance: Concurrent replay accepts once; restart within window cannot replay
Wrong-origin/CSRF/fixation/stale cookie and revoked role fail; valid sign-out removes authorization

tasks.title: openagents.com/signin: the QR and the signed-in state
tasks.body: A Coaxial page draws the QR (HUD, Filament), waits for the phone, then asks it to sign the NIP-98 event and posts it to /auth/nostr. Shows who is signed in (npub, short) and sign out. Plain text in the hidden main for agents.
acceptance: Actual browser waiting/denied/signed-in/signed-out states pass with throwaway phone signer
User private key never enters browser memory; returned signatures are independently verified; visuals pass

tasks.title: End to end: sign in to openagents.com with the phone
tasks.body: The deliverable test: the iOS simulator scans the QR shown by the page (fixture image of the live page's code), approves, and the page reaches the signed-in state with the server session bound to the phone's pubkey. Device run is an owner step in NEEDS_OWNER.md.
acceptance: Simulator plus browser and local relay/server pass happy path, refusal, replay and sign-out
Staging sign-in uses throwaway identity and exact origin/session binding
Physical-device approval/background evidence goes to NEEDS_OWNER.md; real identity requires production cutover

tasks.title: /project/coax reads its project, tasks and order from the relay
tasks.body: Shipped in 2ace224626: project-agnostic Coax relay parsing, event store and task/plan/detail fold with captured-transcript parity and live updates. It trusts the configured relay for signatures. Capped-history catch-up and explicit partial-state hardening are tracked separately by project-live-catchup; cryptographic admission is project-page-verify.
acceptance: Retain committed Coax/model.ts captured-transcript fold parity and live update checks from 2ace224626
Do not claim Coax signature verification or complete catch-up from this resolved transport/fold task

tasks.title: Complete bounded live catch-up across relay caps
tasks.body: The live fold shipped in 2ace224626, but a capped initial REQ/EOSE is not complete history. Add bounded initial backfill for issues/comments/status, missing order-record issue IDs, timestamp ties/budgets and generation-safe reconnect. Keep stable live subscriptions; do not replace a full snapshot with a partial set or treat CLOSED as successful EOSE. Preserve details/plans and make incomplete states explicit. This is relay-trusted display only until local verification.
acceptance: A scripted relay cap below requested limit still loads all155+ known issue rows and older current claims/plans/statuses, matching model.ts
Same-timestamp ambiguity, omitted known order IDs, auth-required CLOSED, reconnect and exhausted budget preserve the last complete view and show incomplete/offline instead of false LIVE
Actual browser task/worker/count state agrees with signature-verified snapshot for a captured fixture, then reflects a newly published update without reload

tasks.title: The live project page verifies every event in Coax
tasks.body: Verify each live event ID/signature and author/project scope in Coax before verified folding/storage. Bound pending work and spend <=4ms/frame; refuse/count forged events. Production verified mode consumes no relay-trusted provisional rows and has no signing/keys/AUTH dependency.
acceptance: A forged event via test relay never enters verified rows or downstream decisions; refusal/pending counts are visible
Signed project changes show in verified rows without release, with explicit incomplete/offline states
Actual Wasm browser transcript agrees with independent TS fold after verification

tasks.title: Reviewed production-secret rollout and recoverable retirement
tasks.body: Gate production identities and removal of working paths on independent review, required target/device evidence, real consumer tests, versioned migration flags and rollback. Test-key development remains unblocked; production identity is never silently introduced.
acceptance: Reviewed source/artifact identities, required owner evidence and staged real-consumer results are pinned
Rollout/rollback is exercised and changed trusted inputs invalidate affected approvals
No self-approved review or unavailable target is counted as passed

tasks.title: INVARIANTS: Coaxial pages draw and compute everything in Coax
tasks.body: Change the INVARIANTS rule as coax/nostr.md §5 says, extend check-visuals.sh to refuse any page script besides host.js and any WebCrypto use, delete coax/web/unlock/, remove bun from deploy.
acceptance: Every old crypto/tool consumer has a verified replacement and rollback evidence before deletion
Check detects extra script/import/WebCrypto paths and seeded hidden dependency; coax/web/unlock retired only after cutover

tasks.title: Source-preserving Coax proto and domain adapters
tasks.body: Use existing generated root proto codecs in real domains; preserve original Nostr/JWS/HOST bytes, compare projections and enforce bounds/presence/unknown policy. DTOs grant no authority and protobuf bytes never replace signature preimages.
acceptance: Actual source fixtures round-trip original bytes through generated codecs; mismatched projections refuse
Policy tests show decoded owner/verified-like unknown flags cannot authorize an effect

tasks.title: FI issuer, audience, algorithm and authenticated JWKS policy
tasks.body: Select exact supported asymmetric algorithms and key-source transports before adding crypto. Bind community Host, issuer, audience, token class/time/TTL; bounded kid/key lookup, pinned authenticated JWKS rotation/cache/revocation and SSRF rules. HOST JOSE profile may reuse primitives but not identity authority.
acceptance: Unknown issuer/community, symmetric/none/confused algorithms and unavailable policy fail closed before network lookup
JWKS redirect/rebinding/stale/oversize/revoked-key fixtures deny under declared transport policy

tasks.title: Selected JWS crypto and exact assertion verification
tasks.body: Implement only the reviewed FI/HOST asymmetric algorithm profiles (P-256, Ed25519 or RSA as explicitly selected). Bounded compact JWS and base64url parser preserves exact signing input; verify signatures before using claims. This is outside Schnorr-only Nostr core.
acceptance: Independent official/negative vectors for selected algorithms and JOSE encodings pass on each advertised target
Algorithm/key confusion, malformed tokens, wrong audience/class/time and unverified claims never authorize
No unsupported JWT algorithm is advertised

tasks.title: HOST invitation and grant admission before effects
tasks.body: Verify original signed invitations/grants with explicit selected signature/JOSE profile; issuer/audience/host/operation scope, redemption, expiry, revocation epochs and replay. No relay/tailnet membership substitutes for grant authority. Its JOSE allowlist is explicitly selected and reviewed, not inferred from FI or Nostr key possession.
acceptance: Wrong host/audience/scope, expired/revoked/replayed grant and unavailable policy refuse before effect
A valid least-privilege throwaway grant admits one bounded operation; original evidence is retained

tasks.title: Block OA owner proofs and AA agent membership
tasks.body: Verify exact owner-attestation conditions, current owner roles, key possession and AA membership policy. Community admission is independent of host grants; revocation applies to both owner and agent.
acceptance: Altered/reordered condition, wrong owner, revoked/banned owner/agent and stale proof refuse
Independent source fixtures exercise direct vs virtual membership and timestamp-vs-kind login policy

tasks.title: Authenticated worker claims with atomic resources and fences
tasks.body: Implement WORK/COORD/CAP/POL resource/grant admission with worker keys, all-or-none revision CAS, fences, renew/release, expiry and reconciliation. Preserve old project-key display-name comments as historical notices only.
acceptance: Two authenticated workers racing overlapping files get exactly one grant; stale fence cannot commit
Lease expiry/reconnect/revocation reconciles before reassignment; display-name comments grant nothing

tasks.title: Claim a task from the page with a signed event
tasks.body: A signed-in authenticated worker requests an atomic COORD claim and displays its actual lease/fence. Existing project-key claim comments are informational history, not evidence of the worker identity. No claim before verified task state/admission.
acceptance: Two workers race for overlapping resources: exactly one grant, the other clean refusal
Renew/release/expiry and stale fence are tested; accepted claim appears on another browser within 5s

tasks.title: GLV endomorphism for faster verification
tasks.body: Optional GLV scalar decomposition only after actual verification arithmetic and a verified real-page benchmark exist. Not a blocker for core integration.
acceptance: One-hour differential fuzz is clean with retained evidence
Record before/after Wasm verify distribution and size; accept optimization only with measured benefit

tasks.title: Verified event storage, replacement, deletion and expiration
tasks.body: Persist immutable originals plus bounded indexes. Implement NIP-01 replacement/ties, NIP-09 authorized deletion and NIP-40 expiration, schema migration and crash/reload without resurrecting records or leaking private data.
acceptance: Reordered/duplicate/same-time/invalid-deletion/expired transcripts converge with independent expected state
Restart/migration/quotas preserve originals and tombstones; unverified events cannot enter store

tasks.title: Multi-relay catch-up and durable offline outbox
tasks.body: Merge verified state across relays; bounded catch-up, duplicate suppression, publish ACK/refusal/unknown status, reconnect and idempotent offline retry. EOSE/short/tied-timestamp pages never prove completeness.
acceptance: Partition/restart/refusal/late-ACK and timestamp-tie tests preserve unknown vs accepted outcomes
Missing dependencies/relay disagreement are surfaced; no duplicate effects or false completeness

tasks.title: REACH generations, route freshness and direct identity
tasks.body: Validate route/advertisement generation and epoch monotonicity, expiry, rollback protection and authenticated direct-channel binding. Host authorization stays independent of reachable addresses.
acceptance: Reordered old routes, rolled-back epochs, expired advert and wrong peer identity refuse
Reconnect/direct and relay fallback preserve identity and never broaden the operation grant

tasks.title: Bounded task delegation, progress, result and PR evidence
tasks.body: Bind WORK/CTX inputs, CAP/POL grants and RUN/SESS journal to one admitted attempt with stable errors/correlation. Preserve original evidence and distinguish running/unknown/failed/completed under reconnect and duplicate delivery.
acceptance: Journal replay/restart converges and cannot execute duplicate requests
Revocation mid-run stops new authorized effects and retains truthful partial/unknown result/PR state

tasks.title: Real Linux Codex task through admitted phone-to-host flow
tasks.body: Throwaway scoped identity/grant in app -> HOST/REACH over Tailscale -> real Linux Codex task -> streamed progress/result/PR -> fenced completion. Production rollout remains a separate cutover gate.
acceptance: App launch shows actual Linux task progress and resulting PR/evidence
Revoked/expired/wrong-scope/replayed request performs no new operation; disconnect outcome remains truthful
Retain reproducible local/staging evidence and explicit owner/device steps

tasks.title: FA origin-bound code exchange and credential sessions
tasks.body: Implement adapter login/code exchange/assertion requests with origin/redirect/secret/session binding and bounded retries. FI/FA credentials and identity metadata remain private.
acceptance: Wrong origin/redirect/code/replayed secret/token class/session expiry refuse
Credentials never enter public discovery, errors or snapshots

tasks.title: Consumer-backed GS, MP, PL and RS proto projections
tasks.body: Add currently absent Block projections and remaining supported official behavior shapes only for named consumers; preserve pins, originals, presence/unknowns and immutable published snapshots. Reserved ER/PMA remain unsupported.
acceptance: Source/hash/profile closure and protoc interoperability pass for new alpha packages
NIP-GS git signing and project MP/PL/RS consumers have explicit acceptance; reserved text does not advertise runtime

tasks.title: CL, DV and WP membership and visibility policy
tasks.body: Live channel/member/owner read-write admission, viewer-private hidden-channel state and profile commands. Visibility is not membership revocation; unknown metadata never authorizes.
acceptance: Cross-owner/channel/private/system/unlisted/hidden cases fail closed correctly
Revocation changes next read/write decision and private visibility never reaches public snapshot

tasks.title: CW composite cursors and bounded completeness
tasks.body: Timestamp+ID cursors, row/depth/window budgets, bound request/signer evidence, ordering and explicit exhaustion. Missing bounds or short relay pages never prove completion.
acceptance: Tied timestamps, reply depth, moving windows and missing pages return deterministic continuation
Wrong viewer/request/relay evidence refuses; no private row leaks through pagination

tasks.title: AR revisions, idempotence and authoritative history
tasks.body: Transactional create/update/move/delete with exact original evidence, prev/root identity, idempotence, read visibility and retention. A decoded revision does not pass CAS.
acceptance: Concurrent prev revisions admit once; duplicate same revision is idempotent
Wrong root/home/owner/stale prev, deleted and invisible records refuse; replay preserves history

tasks.title: IA archive consent and private workspace lifecycle
tasks.body: Implement request/delta/snapshot archive semantics with actor/owner/request binding, consent and relay-scoped UI state. Archiving does not transfer authorship, revoke access or replace channel policy.
acceptance: Wrong actor/owner/request, absent consent and reordered snapshot/delta cases refuse
Two clients converge without leaking private archive state

tasks.title: AE encrypted memories and tombstones
tasks.body: Enforce owner-bound encrypted AE memory, blinded addressing, null tombstones and private plaintext lifetime. Signature precedes decryption; original encrypted evidence remains available for replay.
acceptance: Independent source fixtures cover valid/tombstone/missing/wrong owner and replay
Decrypted body never enters public snapshots or logs; errors wipe owned scratch

tasks.title: AP persona, settings and configuration resolution
tasks.body: Resolve nullable/missing/deleted/unavailable persona/settings/team config with versioned AR-backed snapshots and portable command policy. Unknown or unavailable configuration cannot grant execution.
acceptance: Source fixtures cover null/missing/deleted/unknown config and revision changes
Untrusted persona/command fields cannot broaden CAP/POL/HOST authority

tasks.title: AO ephemeral control and observation without durable logs
tasks.body: Recipient-bound seq/time/correlation/direction checks and bounded live observation. Ephemeral frames are not persisted, indexed or logged, including debug/error paths. Controls require separate operation authority.
acceptance: Wrong recipient/direction/replay/unknown control refuses; authorized observer reconnect respects consent
Persistence/log interception proves plaintext observer frames never enter storage or public telemetry

tasks.title: AM exact private counters and pricing identity
tasks.body: Preserve exact usage/cost decimals, omitted-vs-zero cache fields, cumulative turn/session sequence and independent pricing identity. Metrics are private facts, not inferred payments or grants.
acceptance: Large counters/decimal/source omissions and duplicate/out-of-order cumulative metrics retain exact values
No float rounding, inferred price or plaintext public snapshot leakage

tasks.title: Optional NIP-49 KDF, cipher and normalization primitives
tasks.body: scrypt/Salsa20/8, HChaCha20/XChaCha20 and Poly1305 plus exact NFKC normalization contract, bounded memory/work and erasure. Only required for the optional encrypted-backup profile.
acceptance: Independent vectors and normalization cases pass across advertised native/iOS/Wasm targets
Untrusted memory/KDF parameters refuse within declared budget; error paths wipe buffers

tasks.title: Owner-approved encrypted NIP-49 key import and export
tasks.body: Standard ncryptsec framing and device/browser/native adapters; never substitute a homemade key-wrap format. Explicit approval and resource limits, no public key-backup publication or default plaintext IndexedDB.
acceptance: Official cross-implementation encrypt/decrypt plus wrong password/version/capacity/normalization vectors pass
Owner denial and failure leave no private output or persisted plaintext; optional profile is separately advertised

tasks.title: Consumer-backed relay discovery and optional client NIPs
tasks.body: Add NIP-11 relay capabilities and NIP-65 discovery profiles after core merging; enumerate other official NIPs only with actual consumers. Relay metadata and advertised support are untrusted hints, never authority.
acceptance: Malformed/stale/conflicting relay metadata and unsupported features produce bounded fallback/refusal
Support matrix identifies implemented optional behavior and independent negative fixtures

tasks.title: Optional NIP-17 private conversation profile
tasks.body: Define actual app private messaging over NIP-44/59 with recipient binding, replay/duplicate handling, bounded private history, relay selection and privacy limits; no claim of forward secrecy.
acceptance: Independent two-client send/receive/offline/tamper and recipient-isolation cases pass
Private bodies never appear in public project data or telemetry; unsupported messaging profiles remain hidden

tasks.title: Advertised Nostr profiles match executable conformance
tasks.body: Publish per-profile/target/source/evidence support matrix, version migrations and deliberate unsupported features. Schema/text inventory cannot satisfy runtime evidence. Host/channel production cutover must add domain-specific review, not inherit crypto approval as authorization proof.
acceptance: Native/browser/iOS profile consumers and negative authority/privacy/replay cases pass with pinned artifacts
A planted advertised-but-unimplemented feature fails release; optional backup/messaging only advertised with own evidence
New HOST/FI algorithms, authority policies and optional NIP-49 primitives require their own independent source/artifact review before production; initial core-crypto approval is not inherited

tasks.title: Restore the E0409 compile-time view diagnostic regression
tasks.body: Resolved by cfc36f3ab7: ct_view now returns a safe empty view with no local-array borrow, still reaching E0409. Existing E0383 local-return fixtures remain refused in both modes. The expected diagnostic and lifetime protection were preserved.
acceptance: Focused fixture reaches E0409 for a non-local-borrow compile-time view
Existing E0383 local-return cases remain refused; run only affected diagnostic tests

tasks.title: Close the shipped JSON decoder mutation gaps
tasks.body: The original parser ships and its independent vectors remain useful. Reaching its full decoder/writer closure from a new authority consumer exposes existing mutation survivors. Strengthen state-reuse, exact boundary, UTF-8/escape and writer checks; simplify semantically redundant branches with independent parity evidence. Do not mark equivalents or manufacture scope filters to hide survivors. Keep the separate admission policy and original bytes intact.
acceptance: The actual decoder/writer check closure has zero surviving mutants with no equivalence exemptions
Pinned JSONTestSuite and explicit captured-relay/native trapping allocator regressions pass
Independent parser/admission sanitizer cases preserve original source and documented generic integer compatibility
